constraints: cashflow, stock, contracts, routes, damage, and arrears bound
goals: preserve food, fodder, ammunition, and equipment readiness
reconstruction_policy: Use saved state, standing orders, resources, opposition, exact events, stable seed, and prior receipts. Never award unsupported success or make Tang Wei choices.
replanning_policy: After every settled interval, reassess goals, authority, knowledge, health, resources, dependencies, opposition, constraints, and risk. Continue, block, fail, complete, or supersede the current plan and create a supported successor when the owner remains autonomous.
safe_compaction_policy: A span receipt may cover multiple intervals only when each interval is internally processed in order and material interruptions split the span.
standing_orders: record routine income and expense as conserved aggregate flow
never invent unique property or unsupported windfalls
